original_test_intent: Change SOL enable state for one approved BMC interface/channel, verify both the reported bit and actual authenticated console availability, then return to the captured access policy.
original_method: Preserve both 0x30/0x48 command forms and all copied text as source evidence; execute only after the Wistron contract defines selector/status ordering and the review layer replaces unrelated criteria with SOL-specific acceptance.
manual_activity: The console/security owner identifies the SOL channel and interface, approves enable or disable, supplies an authorized test identity and alternate console, defines expected session behavior and authorizes restoration.

SOL channel, payload instance, port and privilege mapping

Expected enabled and disabled session behaviors
Original-state restore command and explicit approval

engineer_actions: Resolve request framing and copied NTP label
Exclude CPU-power criteria and approve SOL-specific acceptance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its bare OOB request lacks both selector and enable/disable byte and therefore cannot request a defined SOL state; ipmitool lan print does not demonstrate SOL channel behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After contract approval, read baseline with raw 0x30 0x49 [approved-selector-if-required], send one raw 0x30 0x48 <approved-selector/status-layout>, verify read-back and one authorized session outcome, then restore the captured state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source 0x01/0x00 values and 10/5 timing are retained only after correcting their copied NTP label; selector/channel mapping and session window are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the OEM bit to a named SOL channel and security policy, verify the transition at both configuration and authenticated-session layers, then restore without changing credentials or privileges.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces completion plus copied CPU-power text with SOL-specific read-back, access behavior and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct enable bit does not prove usable or appropriately protected SOL access; one successful session does not prove the disabled state denies new access.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Enabling may expose a remote console unexpectedly, while disabling can remove a recovery path or interrupt an active administrative session.

project_override_considerations: Standard ipmitool sol set may substitute only with approved channel and byte/effect equivalence; otherwise it is separate standard-SOL coverage and private 0x30/0x48 remains untested.
expected_evidence: Baseline SOL parameters, sessions and alternate-console availability
Redacted exact set/read-back requests, completions and timing
Authorized session establishment or expected denial with access-control evidence
No privilege/authentication/port change and no unauthorized session
Preserved BMC/SEL/OS/network evidence and no unrelated mutation audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The in-band Procedure uses a byte as Ethernet Interface Select, the note calls request byte 1 NTP Status, OOB supplies no data, and Criteria 2 requires CPU power-cap output. These are incompatible identities and acceptance rules for Set SOL Enable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SOL state-change purpose and paired getter are identifiable. Vendor framing, channel/security inputs and corrected acceptance are resolvable prerequisites, so the case is not irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Restores SOL identity across copied NTP/CPU text, makes the request byte-exact and proves access behavior rather than trusting completion or a configuration bit alone.
independent_technical_reasoning: SOL enablement controls a remote console attack and recovery surface. A completion code cannot show which channel changed, and a read-back bit cannot show whether authorized access works or unauthorized access is prevented. The test therefore needs a named channel, controlled identity, session observation and guaranteed alternate-console recovery before mutation.
